business_scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。
scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。 本期说明：入选原文发表于9月1日至4日，网页补充采用技能规定的90天上限；网页发现渠道占90%，来源多样性未达标。

papers.title: Fast Embeddings on GPUs
papers.abstract: Perplexity 以 Ivy、Tulip 和 ROSE 拆分请求处理、批调度及 GPU 推理，使用整模型 CUDA Graph 和 LazyTensor 重叠 CPU/GPU 工作。小于十亿参数的嵌入模型约 512 token 即可饱和 GPU；以 vLLM 0.22.0、BF16 为基线，验证余弦相似度偏差在 0.1% 内，覆盖多种序列长度、批量及并发配置。
papers.scoring_reason: 直接解决短query嵌入延迟与UGC批量建索引成本；生产栈和多负载基准明确，主要是成熟优化的系统整合。
papers.summary: Perplexity 将 embedding 服务拆为 Rust 网关 Ivy、调度层 Tulip 和推理引擎 ROSE，复用 LLM 内核并用整模型 CUDA Graph 与 LazyTensor 重叠主机和设备工作。原文观察到十亿参数以下模型约 512 token 即可饱和 GPU，并在 BF16、vLLM 0.22.0 对照中验证余弦相似度偏差不超过 0.1%。
papers.key_insight: 社区短文本搜索既有单条 query 的低延迟要求，也有帖子批量建索引的吞吐需求，可分别配置批大小并共享模型内核。优先测量分词、CPU 发射和网络耗时，再尝试延迟捕获计算图；原文指出启动期 p99 会受捕获影响，不能只比较预热后的 GPU 时间，也不能把向量一致性当成 nDCG 或 CTR 提升。
papers.one_line: 用分层服务、计算图和异步结果跟踪优化短 query 的 embedding 计算。

papers.title: AInfer-PD: Communication-Safe In-Place Prefill-Decode Multiplexing for Distributed MoE Rollouts
papers.authors: Wang, Guowei, Yang, Chaokun, Pan, Zhenxuan, Guo, Yuhong, Zhu, Minghua, Zhang, Zhechuan, Wan, Shuo, Zhu, Xiaowei
papers.abstract:
Rollout inference often dominates the wall-clock time of large-scale reinforcement learning (RL). In agentic RL, each trajectory alternates between model generation and environment interaction over multiple turns. Asynchronous trajectories consequently introduce new prefill (P) work while other trajectories remain in decode (D), making P/D coexistence a persistent property of the rollout rather than a one-time prompt-ingestion event.
On shared accelerators, persistent P/D coexistence can make prefill interfere with latency-sensitive decode and prolong rollout completion. P/D disaggregation avoids this co-location but requires separate device pools and KV-cache transfers. In-place multiplexing retains shared devices and KV state, but existing designs lack the communication isolation needed for large MoE deployments that combine attention TP/DP with distributed expert execution. In practical implementations, P and D can issue intersecting collectives in inconsistent cross-rank orders; DeepEP's P and D paths also share mutable protocol state.
We present AInfer-PD, which extends in-place P/D multiplexing to distributed MoE rollouts. AInfer-PD coordinates P/D collective order across ranks and gives the two DeepEP paths independent communication state, making crossed ADP/ATP and DeepEP paths safe for concurrent P/D execution. The design retains shared model weights and KV storage while coordinating P and D on the same devices. Across repeated single-node prefill-intensive workloads, AInfer-PD reduces fixed-workload rollout completion time by 7.1-22.5% relative to the same AInfer engine with P/D multiplexing disabled and by 24.8-32.9% relative to SGLang. On two nodes, the reductions are 18.0-35.3% and 18.3-31.8%, respectively. In a same-engine ablation, fine-grained boundaries reduce completion time by a further 8.6-19.8% over whole-epoch asynchronous enqueue.
papers.scoring_reason: 针对MoE RL rollout的真实通信冲突，具有同引擎消融和一至两节点对照；与偏好中的强化学习直接匹配。
papers.summary: AInfer-PD 面向分布式 MoE 强化学习 rollout，把预填充与解码留在同一设备并共享权重和 KV。系统协调跨 rank 集体通信顺序，隔离 DeepEP 两条路径的协议状态；相对 SGLang，固定负载完成时间在单节点降低 24.8%–32.9%，双节点降低 18.3%–31.8%。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索若使用强化学习训练查询处理模型，多轮生成期间会反复出现预填充与解码混跑，通信顺序和协议状态需要一并设计。原地复用可避免另建资源池及 KV 迁移，但论文主要验证一至两节点 H20-3E；更大集群应先验证通信正确性、尾延迟和吞吐，不能直接外推加速幅度。
papers.one_line: 隔离通信状态，让 MoE rollout 安全地原地混跑预填充与解码。

papers.title: FlowTT: Exploiting Computation Flow Reuse in Irregular Tensor-Train Embedding
papers.abstract: Tensor-Train (TT) decomposition effectively compresses large embedding tables in recommendation models, but TT-based embedding lookup remains inefficient because partially shared computation flows across input indices are not fully reused and intermediate results are repeatedly materialized off-chip between sequential TT-core contractions. We present FlowTT, a flow-aware GPU execution framework that reformulates TT gather as a set of prefix-shared irregular computation flows. FlowTT combines flow-aligned prefix-based index grouping, a fused TT-embedding execution path with on-chip intermediate retention, and persistent-thread scheduling with chunk-based work stealing and L2 checkpointing to preserve reuse under skewed workloads. By co-designing task formation, data buffering, and scheduling with the structure of TT gather, FlowTT reduces redundant TT-core operations, global-memory traffic, and load imbalance. On Meta's synthetic recommendation benchmarks (Meta-240, Meta-480, and Meta-788), FlowTT consistently achieves the lowest latency compared to existing methods. At batch size 32,768, it reduces latency by up to 42.2% in inference and 49.2% in training relative to EcoRec, while also achieving the lowest inference peak memory usage. These results show that exposing prefix-shared computation is key to efficient TT-based embedding execution.
papers.scoring_reason: 优化搜推稀疏嵌入执行；共享前缀和片上保留结合明确，提供合成基准及调度消融，尚无UGC线上指标。
papers.summary: FlowTT 针对张量列车压缩 embedding 查表中的重复计算与片外搬运，按索引共享前缀组织计算流，并结合融合内核、片上中间结果保留、任务窃取和 L2 复用。在 Meta 的三组合成推荐基准上，批量 32768 时相对 EcoRec 的推理与训练延迟最多分别降低 42.2% 和 49.2%。
papers.key_insight: 对社区搜索排序中的大规模稀疏特征表，压缩率之外还应衡量解压查表的执行成本。可借鉴按共享前缀成组和动态调度的设计，评估热点特征分布下的复用收益；这些结果来自合成推荐数据和较大批量，迁移前需用真实 UGC 请求分布验证小批量延迟、排序精度与显存开销。
papers.one_line: 共享前缀计算使压缩嵌入查表推理延迟最多降低 42.2%。

papers.title: MeanField Surrogate Modeling for Scalable Runtime Scheduling of Concurrent Heterogeneous AI Inference on Shared GPUs
papers.abstract: Deploying heterogeneous AI models concurrently on a shared GPU introduces resource contention that complicates runtime scheduling. While surrogate models avoid costly online benchmarking, their profiling requirements typically grow combinatorially with the number of co-running models, limiting scalability. We propose a MeanField surrogate that predicts per-model performance from local configuration and aggregate GPU state rather than explicitly modeling all joint interactions. Experiments on concurrent LLM and vision workloads across $N \in \{2,3,4,5,6\}$ show high predictive accuracy ($R^2 \approx 0.96$) with an empirical sample budget that grows approximately linearly in $N$, in contrast to the combinatorial cost of fully joint profiling. Integrated into a genetic algorithm scheduler, the surrogate scales to an $N=5$ problem with 78,732 feasible joint configurations, remaining within 0.10% of the exhaustive search with zero SLA violations across eight dynamic workload scenarios, while complete online GA decisions take 26 ms median, about $5\times$ faster than exhaustive surrogate search.
papers.scoring_reason: 多模型混部调度适用于搜推共享GPU；近线性采样成本有价值，但验证仅覆盖单RTX 3090和有限模型。
papers.summary: MeanField 用单模型配置和聚合 GPU 状态预测混部性能，避免枚举所有模型组合，实验预测 R² 约 0.96。结合遗传算法后，在五模型、78732 种可行配置中，调度结果距穷举不超过 0.10%，八类动态负载无 SLA 违约，决策耗时中位数为 26 毫秒。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索的 embedding、重排和内容理解服务共享 GPU 时，可用聚合资源状态降低混部性能建模成本。适合先建立离线画像并在资源控制层试验，26 毫秒调度耗时未必适合逐请求调用；论文测试平台为单张 RTX 3090，换到生产 GPU、模型组合或突发流量后需要重新校准。
papers.one_line: 以聚合 GPU 状态近似混部干扰，减少调度画像采样成本。

papers.title: RT-HiSS: Ray Tracing Accelerated High Dimensional Vector Similarity Searches
papers.abstract: Recent GPU generations include special-purpose ray tracing (RT) cores for graphics applications. While RT cores are primarily used for rendering, recent works show they can be leveraged for general-purpose tasks, including similarity searches. However, existing approaches do not support datasets exceeding three dimensions. In this work, we propose RT-HiSS, the first exact GPU RT-core-based similarity search algorithm for high-dimensional datasets. GPU similarity search often scales poorly for large datasets with substantial search distances. To address this, RT-HiSS uses RT cores for fast index construction and searches, followed by candidate refinement on CUDA cores. We introduce a two-pass approach to estimate an upper bound on result size, enabling efficient batching under GPU memory constraints with near-perfect load balancing. Additionally, we examine shared memory tiling and compressed result masks to improve GPU resource utilization. RT-HiSS yields speedups up to 8.37$\times$ over competitive state-of-the-art GPU algorithms and up to 2,368.26$\times$ relative to the brute-force algorithm across six real-world datasets.
papers.scoring_reason: 向量基础设施核心工作，六个数据集及消融完整；固定半径精确搜索和RT硬件要求限制直接接入Top-K召回。
papers.summary: RT-HiSS 将高维固定半径精确相似性搜索拆为 RT 核候选过滤和 CUDA 核精确校验，并通过两遍搜索估计结果规模以安排显存内批处理。在六个真实数据集上，相对有竞争力的 GPU 算法最高加速 8.37 倍；实验使用具有 16 GiB 显存的 Quadro RTX 5000。
papers.key_insight: 社区 UGC 的近重复内容检测或阈值邻域构建可以探索这类硬件协同过滤。论文研究的是固定半径精确检索，迁移到语义 Top-K 召回需要另外验证算法和数据分布；部署也要求具备 RT 核，不能默认沿用现有训练卡。应同时测量建索引、候选校验、结果传输及真实向量维度下的性能。
papers.one_line: RT 核过滤配合 CUDA 校验，加速固定半径精确向量检索。

papers.title: Latency-Aware Orchestration for Multi-Agent LLM Workflows on Heterogeneous GPUs
papers.authors: Wang, Jinghao, Zhang, Yifeng, Zhou, Xiao, Lu, Yao, Zhang, Yihui, Sun, Xiaoyang, Wo, Tianyu, Wang, Xu, Hu, Chunming, Yang, Renyu
papers.abstract: Concurrent multi-agent workflows expose future dependencies and serving-state requirements while running on heterogeneous GPU pools with time-varying load, model residency, and resource availability. The logical workflow defines the required computation, whereas its physical scheduling units, model-lifecycle actions, resource ordering, and placement must be selected according to the observed pool state. We present a prediction-guided runtime that uses workflow forecasts to construct and optimize a physical execution graph. Predictor estimates device-specific activation latency, peak memory, and model-loading cost, then propagates these predictions through workflow dependencies to forecast activation readiness and future model demand. Constructor builds semantics-preserving fusion and model-lifecycle alternatives, while Scheduler jointly optimizes their selection, placement, and execution order based on the live pool state. Across a workload spanning three workflow scenarios on a heterogeneous GPU pool, our system reduces end-to-end makespan and overall p95 completion latency under burst arrivals by up to 36.8% and 25.9%, respectively, over state-of-the-art workflow schedulers. It also saves up to 24.63 GPU-s per completed session.
papers.scoring_reason: 适合多模型搜索工作流资源调度；同时优化执行图、模型驻留和设备放置，但接入现有运行时需要工程改造。
papers.summary: 该系统根据工作流依赖预测激活时机、显存和模型加载成本，再联合选择节点融合、模型生命周期及异构 GPU 放置方案。在三种工作流场景中，相比已有调度器，突发到达负载的总完成时间和整体 p95 延迟最多降低 36.8% 与 25.9%，每次会话最多节省 24.63 GPU 秒。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索若串联查询理解、检索后推理和答案检查，可把整条计算图及模型驻留需求提供给资源调度器，而不只处理独立请求。实践中先记录各阶段耗时与峰值显存，再试验提前加载和节点融合；收益依赖预测准确性及异构设备状态，需要在真实请求突发和模型切换条件下复测。
papers.one_line: 联合优化执行图与模型驻留，突发负载 p95 最多降低 25.9%。

papers.title: Every Kernel Is a Join: Automatic Multi-GPU Parallelism for AI Computations in Einsummable
papers.authors: Ding, Zhimin, Liao, Chen-Kuan, Adiole, Chima, Barrow, Brianna, Du, Fangzhou, Hsiao, Yu, Huang, Ge, Jin, Yicheng, Syed, Ismail, Jermaine, Chris
papers.abstract: Distributing an AI computation across the GPUs of a multi-GPU server is one of the central problems in systems-for-AI. We present Einsummable, a prototype system that accepts a PyTorch-like description of an AI computation and automatically distributes it across a multi-GPU server, with no device assignments, sharding annotations, or communication operations written by the programmer. Einsummable models every operation as a relational join followed by an aggregation over tensor relations, in which the tuples contain sub-tensors. Each operation exposes its possible decompositions through what we call "join-agg specs". An optimizer then selects decompositions across the whole computation to minimize a communication-cost proxy. Because it searches decompositions rather than a menu of named strategies, Einsummable discovers plans that mesh-based auto-parallelizers cannot. Each decomposed operation is implemented by synthesizing an exchange program, which is a topology-aware generalization of Volcano's exchange operator. Einsummable invokes no canned collectives: all communication and aggregation is special-purpose, derived at compile time. Despite being fully automatic, Einsummable can outperform custom-designed implementations. For example, on LLaMA transformer blocks on an eight-GPU A100 server, Einsummable achieves a geometric-mean runtime of 8.97 ms, versus 13.80 ms for hand-tuned PyTorch and 15.90 ms for vLLM.
papers.scoring_reason: 自动多GPU划分与社区搜索模型部署相关；连接聚合抽象有明确创新，仍为原型；正文有多负载和优化器消融。
papers.summary: Einsummable 把 AI 算子表示为张量关系上的连接与聚合，自动搜索跨 GPU 分解方案，并生成拓扑感知的通信程序。正文实验中，八张 A100 上 LLaMA Transformer 块的几何平均运行时间为 8.97 毫秒，手工 PyTorch 与 vLLM 基线分别为 13.65 和 14.87 毫秒。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索的大模型训练和推理可借鉴以通信成本统一选择算子切分的思路，减少逐层手写并行策略的负担。该系统仍是原型，结果针对 Transformer 块，不能等同于完整搜索服务加速；摘要页基线写作 13.80 和 15.90 毫秒，与正文不一致，本报告采用正文实验数值。
papers.one_line: 将算子转为连接聚合，自动生成多 GPU 分解与通信方案。

papers.title: mzCache: On-Device LLM Memory Management under Multitasking
papers.authors: Yu, Hongseung, Kim, Minsung, Park, Jongseok, Lee, Kyunghan
papers.abstract: On-device mobile Large Language Model (LLM) inference is gaining significant attention. However, mobile devices operate in highly dynamic multitasking environments where users frequently switch between applications. This creates memory pressure, forcing LLM memory (model weights and KV cache) to be evicted by the operating system. When a new inference request arrives, the inference system must restore the evicted memory through slow storage reads or recompute the entire KV cache, severely degrading responsiveness. To address this, we present mzCache, an on-device LLM inference system with specialized memory management for multitasking environments. Under unpredictable memory pressure, mzCache elastically evicts LLM memory and leverages the unified memory of mobile SoCs to enable zero-wait inference on the GPU with concurrent CPU-side restoration. mzCache realizes this through restoration-oriented memory management: LLM memory is partitioned into fine-grained shared buffers to enable partial eviction and restoration with concurrent cross-processor access, while hybrid swap and backward-out eviction policies ensure low-latency restoration from any eviction state. Implemented on this http URL and deployed as an Android application, mzCache achieves 2.1-5.5$\times$ reduction in Time-to-First-Token compared to storage-backed partial offload and demonstrates its effectiveness in real multitasking scenarios.
papers.scoring_reason: Android及llama.cpp实现和多任务实验支持落地，内存恢复机制明确；端侧搜索不是当前云端UGC主链路。
papers.summary: mzCache 针对手机多任务引起的 LLM 权重和 KV 缓存驱逐，把内存拆成细粒度共享缓冲区，让 GPU 推理与 CPU 恢复并行，并采用混合交换和逆序驱逐策略。系统基于 llama.cpp 实现并部署为 Android 应用，相对存储支撑的部分卸载方案，首 token 等待时间改善 2.1–5.5 倍。
papers.key_insight: 若社区产品尝试端侧查询理解或隐私搜索，用户切换应用后的恢复时间可能比连续生成速度更影响体验。可借鉴面向恢复顺序管理权重及 KV 的设计，测试内存压力下的首 token 延迟和能耗；目前证据来自手机统一内存环境，迁移到云端独立显存服务需要重新设计共享缓冲与恢复机制。
papers.one_line: 重构手机 LLM 内存恢复，改善应用切换后的首 token 延迟。

papers.title: CREDIT: Cost-guided Reduction-reuse with Efficient DSMEM Inter-CTA Tiling
papers.authors: Li, Zhengxiong, Huang, Tsung-Wei, Ogras, Umit
papers.abstract: NVIDIA distributed shared memory (DSMEM) enables direct shared-memory access within a thread block cluster. However, cluster synchronization, remote access, and resource costs make it difficult to determine when DSMEM improves performance. To fill this gap, we propose CREDIT, a cost-guided framework that identifies DSMEM-profitable workload patterns, predicts their profitability range, and delivers consistent speedups across diverse workloads. CREDIT combines three innovations: (1) a profiling-driven characterization that identifies workload patterns likely to benefit from DSMEM; (2) a transformation that applies DSMEM to reduction-reuse workloads; (3) a cost model based on profiling data, to determine its profitability range. Evaluations on diverse workloads show CREDIT achieves 91.7% prediction accuracy on profitability. CREDIT beats this http URL, Triton, and optimized non-DSMEM CUDA baselines on all six workloads, with geometric-mean speedups of 1.466x on RTX 5090 and 1.318x on H100. CREDIT's source code is publicly available at this https URL.
papers.scoring_reason: 开源成本模型指导DSMEM内核改造，跨两类GPU及六类负载验证；对UGC搜索的收益需定位到具体算子。
papers.summary: CREDIT 为 NVIDIA 分布式共享内存建立收益成本模型，识别适合跨线程块归约复用的工作负载，并据此改写内核。实验对是否值得采用 DSMEM 的预测准确率达 91.7%；六种负载上，相对所选基线的几何平均加速在 RTX 5090 和 H100 上分别为 1.466 与 1.318 倍。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索若已把 embedding 或重排瓶颈定位到归约类 GPU 算子，可先按共享复用量、远程访问和同步成本筛选优化机会。开源实现提供了清晰起点，但不应把内核平均加速当成整条检索链路收益；建议保留原内核，在实际形状、并发和目标 GPU 上逐项测量后再切换。
papers.one_line: 用成本模型判断跨线程块共享内存优化是否值得采用。

papers.title: Frontier Reasoning Reaches the Edge: How to Deploy and Optimize Models on NVIDIA Jetson
papers.authors: Khalil BenKhaled, Aditya Sahu, Chitoku Yato
papers.abstract: Running reasoning and agentic AI at the edge has been harder than it needs to be. Until recently, models capable of multi-step reasoning were too large to run...
papers.scoring_reason: 公开容器和模型配置可直接复现；量化与推测解码组合实用，但仅特定Jetson模型且与云端搜索关联间接。
papers.summary: NVIDIA 给出 Jetson 上结合 NVFP4 量化与推测解码的部署方案，对 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 选用 DSpark，对 Qwen3.8-27B 选用 DFlash2。相对 BF16，解码吞吐最高提高 6.28 倍；四类 SpeedBench 负载下，两者分别达到 123.01–138.02 和 27.69–34.44 token/s。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索若探索边缘端答案生成，可先复用公开量化模型、草稿模型及 vLLM 配置，再用真实 UGC 问题测量质量和速度。不同架构的最佳草稿方案并不一致，文章也要求检查草稿接受率；6.28 倍是特定平台配置的最高值，不能直接作为服务器成本预算或搜索相关性提升预期。
papers.one_line: 量化叠加推测解码，在 Jetson 指定配置上最高实现 6.28 倍解码吞吐。
